name: Step 5 Preview
title: Step 5 Preview: price, context window and specs
answer: Step 5 Preview is a model in StepFun's StepFun Step family, first listed on 2026-10-08. It takes text, image and video in and returns text, with a context window of 1 million tokens and up to 64K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $1 per million input tokens and $2.7 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the newest of the 3 versions of StepFun Step listed today.
Its input price is above the family median of $0.2 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
